characteristics.name: Condition Text
characteristics.$text: When this card is assigned, if it is not already in play, the player who assigned it searches the Damage Deck for 1 Damage card with the Pilot trait and may place it faceup on this card. Then shuffle the Damage Deck. When you suffer critical damage during an attack, you are instead dealt the chosen faceup Damage card. When there is no Damage card on this card, remove it.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Immediately before you reveal your dial, if you are not stressed, you must execute a white [left bank 1], [straight 1], or [right bank 1] maneuver.

characteristics.name: System Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking with your primary weapon, if you have a target lock on the defender, you may add 1 [critical] result to your roll. If you do, you cannot spend target locks during this attack.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack, you may perform a free cloak action.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains the [jam] action icon.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, you may spend a focus token to change 1 of your [focus] results to a [critical] result.

characteristics.name: Cargo Ability
characteristics.$text: You may dock up to 4 TIE fighters, TIE Interceptors, TIE bombers, or TIE Advanced to this ship. All of these ships must have the same ship type.

characteristics.name: Hardpoint Ability
characteristics.$text: Attack (energy): Spend 1 energy from this card to perform this attack against 1 ship (even a ship outside of your firing arc).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose up to 2 friendly ships at Range 1-2 and assign 1 focus token to each of these ships. Then receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: You may equip up to 2 different Modification upgrades (instead of 1).  You cannot equip this card if your pilot skill value is "4" or lower.

characteristics.name: Elite Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that hits, you must choose 1 other ship at Range 1 of the defender (other than yourself). That ship suffers 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking with a primary weapon from your primary firing arc, you may roll 1 additional attack die. If you do not, you may perform an additional attack from your auxiliary firing arc.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a green maneuver, choose another friendly ship at Range 1. That ship may acquire a target lock.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar loses all [torpedoes], [missiles], and [bomb] upgrade icons and gains 2 [crew] upgrade icons. You cannot equip a [crew] Upgrade card that costs more than 4 squad points.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, after you perform an attack with a [cannon] secondary weapon that costs 3 or fewer squad points, you may perform a primary weapon attack.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you acquire a target lock, you may perform a free evade action.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [system] upgrade icon. If you equip a [system] upgrade, its squad point cost is reduced by 4 (to a minimum of 0).

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar loses the [cannon] and [missiles] upgrade icons. After executing a 3-, 4-, or 5-speed maneuver, if you did not overlap an obstacle or ship, you may perform a free evade action.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Energy: You may remove up to 3 shields from your ship. For each shield removed, gain 1 energy.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the first round, choose 1 enemy small or large ship. When attacking or defending against that ship, you may change 1 of your [focus] results to a [hit] or [evade] result.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, if the targeted section has a reinforce token, you may change 1 [focus] result to a [evade] result.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: If you overlap an obstacle during the Activation phase, do not suffer 1 faceup damage card. Instead, roll 1 attack die. On a [hit] or [critical] result, suffer 1 damage.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack against an enemy ship, you may suffer 2 damage to cause that ship to suffer 1 critical damage.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver that causes you to overlap another ship, you may perform 1 free action. Then receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, before a friendly ship rolls dice, you may name a die result. After rolling, you must change 1 of its dice results to the named result. That die result cannot be modified again.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Choose up to 3 friendly ships at Range 1-2. Assign 1 focus token to each of those ships and assign the "Fanatical Devotion" Condition card to 1 of them. Then receive 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Condition Text
characteristics.$text: When defending, you cannot spend focus tokens. When attacking, if you spend a focus token to change all [focus] results to [hit] results, set aside the first [focus] result that you change. The set-aside [hit] result cannot be canceled by defense dice, but the defender may cancel [critical] results before it. During the End phase, remove this card.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, you may choose another ship at Range 1-4. Either remove 1 focus token from the chosen ship or assign 1 focus token to that ship.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform an attack that destroys an enemy ship, you may acquire a target lock.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a recover action, recover 1 additional shield.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Combat phase, choose an unstressed enemy ship at Range 1-2. Its owner must assign a stress token to it or assign a stress token to another ship at Range 1-2 of you that that player controls.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Assign the "I'll Show You the Dark Side" Condition card to an enemy ship at Range 1-3.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the end of the Combat phase, each enemy ship at Range 1 that does not have a stress token receives 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: When you are dealt a faceup Damage card, you may discard this Upgrade card or another [crew] Upgrade card to flip that Damage card facedown (without resolving its effect).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Action: Execute a white [straight 1] maneuver.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, the first ship that declares you as the target of an attack immediately recieves 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When you deploy a ship, treat its pilot skill value as "8" until the end of the round.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When acquiring a target lock, you may lock onto any enemy ship in the play area.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Once per round, after you acquire a target lock on an enemy ship, you may remove 1 focus, evade, or blue target lock token from that ship.

characteristics.name: Huge Ship Title Ability
characteristics.$text: After you execute a maneuver, you may deploy up to 4 docked ships (instead of 2).

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: At the start of the Combat phase, if you have no shields and at least 1 Damage card assigned to your ship, you may perform a free evade action.

characteristics.name: Modification Ability
characteristics.$text: When defending, after rolling defense dice, if there are more attack dice than defense dice, roll 1 additional defense die.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains 2 [cannon] upgrade icons. You may perform attacks with [cannon] secondary weapons that cost 2 or fewer squad points even while you have a weapons disabled token.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: When attacking, if the defender is the only ship in your firing arc at Range 1-3, you may reroll 1 attack die. When defending, you may discard this card to reroll all of your defense dice.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Your upgrade bar gains the [torpedoes] and [missiles] upgrade icons. You may perform attacks with [torpedoes] and [missiles] secondary weapons against ships you have locked even while you have a weapons disabled token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After another friendly ship at Range 1 becomes the defender, if you are inside the attacker's firing arc at Range 1-3, the attacker receives 1 stress token.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: During setup, before the "Place Forces" step, assign the "Optimized Prototype" Condition to a friendly Galactic Empire ship with 3 or fewer shields.

characteristics.name: Condition Text
characteristics.$text: Increase your shield value by 1. Once per round, when performing a primary weapon attack, you may spend 1 die result to remove 1 shield token from the defender. After you perform a primary weapon attack, a friendly ship at Range 1-2 equipped with the "Director Krennic" Upgrade card may acquire a target lock on the defender.

characteristics.name: Title Ability
characteristics.$text: Treat your [left bank 3] and [right bank 3] maneuvers as white. Immediately before you reveal your dial, if you are not stressed, you must execute a white [left bank 1], [straight 1], or [right bank 1] maneuver.

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: Your action bar gains [coordinate].

characteristics.name: Crew Ability
characteristics.$text: After you perform a jam action against an enemy ship, you may choose a ship at Range 1 of that ship that is not jammed and assign it 1 jam token.
